attBesluta.text: Great kit for pulling and installed harmonic balancers. Used on for 289 and 351w without issue.
Much easier than trying to find a bolt to use and cheaper was very happy with it
The vevor harmonic balancer puller/ installer worked like a charm on my 97' Cherokee xj.
It worked perfect. I was on. It was able to remove the harmonic balancer off my 2001 Toyota tundra.
Worked very nice to install Harmonic balancer for me! 3.5 ford Duratec engine.

Seems to be a good quality Removal tool I used it today on a Ford 5.4 Liter and didn't have any problems the down side to it is there is a good bit of pieces to put together but seems to be well made just takes a minute to put it together but at the end of the day it does it s job
Its a nice kit but the circular plate was too small for installing the harmonic balancer back on (Ford Expedition). I think if the circular plate had a lil larger diameter, it would be a great kit.
